program: Medicare Shared Savings Program — APP Plus
verification_scope: Program membership, official titles, performance-year applicability, and specification-variant locations are verified. Detailed clinical specification fields remain unresolved and non-public.

measures.name: Diabetes: Glycemic Status Assessment Greater Than 9%
measures.description: Percentage of patients 18-75 years of age with diabetes who had a glycemic status assessment greater than 9.0% during the measurement period.

measures.name: Breast Cancer Screening
measures.description: Percentage of women 40-74 years of age who had a mammogram to screen for breast cancer in the 27 months before the end of the measurement period.

measures.name: Colorectal Cancer Screening
measures.description: Percentage of patients 45-75 years of age who had appropriate screening for colorectal cancer.

measures.name: Preventive Care and Screening: Screening for Depression and Follow-Up Plan
measures.description: Percentage of patients aged 12 years and older screened for depression using an age-appropriate standardized tool with a documented follow-up plan when the screen is positive.

measures.name: Controlling High Blood Pressure
measures.description: Percentage of patients 18-85 years of age with essential hypertension whose most recent blood pressure was adequately controlled below 140/90 mmHg during the measurement period.

measures.name: CAHPS for MIPS
measures.description: A CMS-administered survey measure of patients' experiences of care for groups and APM Entities, including Shared Savings Program ACOs.

measures.name: Hospital-Wide, 30-day, All-Cause Unplanned Readmission (HWR) Rate for MIPS Eligible Clinician Groups
measures.description: A risk-standardized measure of unplanned readmissions within 30 days for Medicare fee-for-service beneficiaries aged 65 or older.

measures.name: Clinician and Clinician Group Risk-standardized Hospital Admission Rates for Patients with Multiple Chronic Conditions
measures.description: A risk-standardized rate of acute, unplanned hospital admissions among Medicare fee-for-service patients aged 65 or older with multiple chronic conditions.

excluded_variant_candidates.reason: The bundle contains Medicare Part B Claims specifications as supporting QPP artifacts, but the CY2025 PFS final-rule APP Plus phase-in table, the PY2025 quality-performance-standard roster, the CMS program guidance page, and Methodology Version 13 explicitly identify eCQM, MIPS CQM, and Medicare CQM as the reportable clinical collection types for Shared Savings Program ACOs. The Part B Claims artifacts are therefore not imported as APP Plus variants.
